purpose: S5R3 neural-only main comparison, user-accepted fixed learned reference; 20 paired seeds.
method: A_update=alpha*A_ref+beta*Delta_A; both centered under the current policy
primary_metric: normalized trapezoidal success mean over recorded updates 0..128
screening: Five preselected seed IDs, SHA256 order independent of outcomes; all settings to update 128.
promotion: Top four screen settings, full (1,1), transferred S5 exact winner (2,32), and best positive diagonal; all 20 seeds to 128.
selection: Highest all-20-seed early mean among promoted; ties prefer smaller alpha+beta, alpha, beta, ID. Continue winner to 512.
reference_pairing: Neural uses the SAME task-specific 20 seeds and replay schedules as exact.
neural_exact_acceptance: Absolute difference of selected-configuration all-20 early means <=0.05; report paired CI and signed gap. Never drop seeds or failed tasks to meet this criterion.
neural_reference: Fixed step-166400 S5R3 anchor, explicitly accepted despite original Q-MAE threshold; no reference fitting or exact residual repair.
reference_release: REFERENCE_USE.json authorizes the unchanged checkpoint. Original accuracy thresholds remain diagnostic and their outcome is preserved. Finiteness, materialization consistency and implementation checks remain mandatory.
resource_policy: Eight GPUs; one resident search/baseline worker per GPU.
baseline_scope: All seven existing baseline families on the same fixed neural reference, common actor/critic starts and 20 original task seeds; all 31 archived recipe settings to 128 updates, select within each method by all-20 early mean, continue selected recipes to 512.
inference: Development tuning on the same cohort used for reporting; no held-out or global-optimum claim.
checkpoint_scope: Complete model, optimizer and RNG states; immutable original data and schedules linked read-only.
requested_panel_condition: Add S5R3 neural to existing main plots when selected PDR mean exceeds the strongest reported baseline at both early mean (0..128) and final success (512). Baseline settings selected by early mean; keep all outcomes independently of this presentation condition.
implementation_checks: Shared initial parameters/optimizer/RNG and schedules; full detached AWAC weights; finite gradients; complete checkpoint restore.
statistical_comparisons: 10000 paired-seed bootstrap resamples; development-cohort inference, not held-out testing.
